flag_name: a digital asset or the digital sector
definition: Counts: digital networks, hosting, platforms and systems, monitoring, warning and control systems, digital equipment, digital services, digital-sector policy and regulation, digital skills, and e-waste from digital equipment. Does not count: roads, buildings, energy access for households or non-digital facilities, agriculture, water, general institutional strengthening, or anything with no digital system, network, facility or equipment involved. A sentence counts as digital when it, read with its paragraph, is about something digital.

A law, regulation, strategy, standard, code, guideline, institutional procedure or plan that governs behaviour beyond a single asset purchase. It is not an investment, where the project builds, buys, installs, upgrades, operates or designs something. Technical assistance to design or run a specific system is an investment; technical assistance to draft a regulation is policy.
